tagline: Turn Android into a Linux Gamepad
brief: A high-performance bridge that transforms Android devices into low-latency virtual controllers and keyboards for Linux with an embedded Mini AI game assistant.

concepts.name: The Synapse Controller
concepts.idea: Contoured ergonomic controller silhouette with central wireless transmission node.
rationale: Unmistakable handheld controller contour instantly communicates the core purpose of DroidPad.
Internal negative-space D-pad on the left and diamond button cluster on the right provide perfect tactile cues.
Central vertical pill represents the wireless pulse link between the mobile transmitter and the Linux kernel receiver.

recommendation: The Synapse Controller creates an instantly recognisable icon for both the Android Launcher and the Linux Desktop, scaling effortlessly down to a 16px system tray indicator.
